rules: Treat 8-12 minutes as the normal news/topic explainer envelope, not a quota.
Choose actual duration from substantive information density and user value.
Do not pad a thin topic with irrelevant history, repeated framing, slow narration, low-information filler, or unrelated tangents.
A shorter treatment is allowed when the verified material cannot responsibly support 8 minutes.
Longer than 12 minutes requires substantive value such as mechanism, stakeholder impact, material chronology, evidence, uncertainty, credible competing interpretation, or next watchpoints.
Remove duplicated explanations before removing substantive context.
Keep full spoken-word subtitle coverage at 100 percent.
Do not add fixed cut or motion intervals solely to hold attention; use semantic beats.
Explainer/background diagrams remain stationary by default; local pointer, highlight, reveal, or evidence emphasis may move when semantically justified.
Subtitle body text is white with active-speaker bright identity frame/accent: green for Zundamon and pink/magenta for Shikoku Metan.
